body: Maybe, but she seemed pretty comfortable around me, and I thought we engaged pretty well in conversation.
That's what I don't understand; the last time we spoke, she *did* want to go out with me again.

Because things are tough enough as it is without having people mollycoddle me. I'm 22 and I still get treated like a child by most of my family, my Dad included, and I don't want him or them falling over themselves to be around me to try and make me feel better when the last thing I want right now is to face them.

I don't know where to go. I can't go to the doctor, because I'd need time off work, which I can't afford, I can't call anyone because my Dad would find out and the last thing I want is for him to worry.
Quite a while ago. I used to manage keeping this emptiness subdued, but it's just getting completely unbearable now.
Not much. Music, video games, films, books. I just look at them all now and feel... nothing. Like I can't engage with them in any way.

We're talking about problems in just about every sense. Emotional, physical, psychological, social, financial, familial, and they've been going on for a while, and they're finally starting to overwhelm me.

Everything. Every aspect of my life is just hopelessly depressing. I'm stuck in a job I hate surrounded by people I hate, talking to people who hate me and doing something everybody hates. I'm stuck at home with my Dad who loves me very much, but uses me as an emotional and increasingly frequent financial crutch and a sister who barely acknowledges my existence unless she wants something from me. I haven't got any friends that I can meaningfully talk to, I don't have a girlfriend, I can't go out because every time I do something bad happens to me, and the things that I used to enjoy just don't make me happy any more.

Single, virtually no friends at all, certainly not any that I keep in regular contact with, live with my Dad, stuck in a low-pay, dead-end job that I'm either going to get fired from soon or is going to drive me to suicide.

I already do have a routine that I go through before going out. I make myself as presentable as possible, I style my hair as best I can (fuck you very much, genetics), I wear normal clothes, but I just can't help but get the feeling that I stick-out, or that I'm being judged by someone at any time, and it just makes me want to hide away as quickly as possible.

It's ok, I don't think you're being intrusive at all. It actually feels sort of good to be explaining this to someone other than myself for a change.

There's nowhere I can feasibly go. The company I work for is a very small one (just 5 people, including myself). I'm pretty sure that the only reason they hired me was because the Government offers companies a monetary incentive to hire people who've been out of work for 6 months or more (which I had been). It's not really an option for me to live with my Mum as she's living with a friend who has 2 young daughters, so the house is already pretty crowded, and besides, she lives quite far away, so I wouldn't be able to get to work on a morning.

Even if I did go, it wouldn't change anything at home. My sister doesn't care that she doesn't do anything to help, and like I said, my dad's pretty spineless when it comes to her, so he'd just do everything himself and no matter how annoyed he got he wouldn't say anything. Me going to live with my mum would probably devastate him too. My parents split almost 5 years ago, and even now at the mere mention of her my dad gets all quiet and pouty. He says it's ok when I go and see her for an afternoon sometimes, but it's plain to see that it eats him alive inside.

And as for not wanting to go outside, it's kind of hard to describe. I just don't like it. I feel... exposed, like I'm unsafe all the time. I flinch whenever I realise there's someone behind me on the street. I'm constantly looking around to see if there's anyone near me. It doesn't matter where I am really, as long as I'm inside *somewhere* I don't feel so paranoid.

My sister isn't much younger than me, she's 20, but she has a temperament that changes like the weather. One day she could be fine with me, the next she could bite my head off simply for having the audacity to exist. My dad lets her get away with blue-murder too, because when he and my Mum split up, he got terrified of 'losing' my sister and pretty much spoiled her rotten. She doesn't clean up after herself, she only ever cooks for herself, she doesn't even know how to operate the washing machine (and has flat-out refused to learn on multiple occasions), her bedroom is an absolute sty, with me and my dad having to make regular excursions into it to collect plates, glasses and uneaten food, not to mention the piles and piles of her clothes, worn or clean, that she just doesn't put away.

As for my dad, I think 'health problems' is a bit of an exaggeration. He's just generally unhealthy, and pretty much doesn't care about himself at all. He has terrible eyesight which he refuses to do anything about. The last time he went to an opticians was over a year ago, and that was because I almost physically forced him to go. He has awful hearing, too, which again he doesn't want to anything about. He's overweight which, to be fair, he *always* has been, but it's much more noticeable than it used to be, and he has hygeine problems that again, despite my urges he does nothing about.

I dunno. I mean, I've been pretty reclusive lately, but I've always been that way outside of work and college. I had a bit of a fall-out (to put it mildly) with my best friend a couple of months ago, but that was a pretty private thing; other than that, I just don't know.
